definitions.gloss: provisional hiring; probationary employment; tentative appointment
definitions.explanation: A period of trial employment where the hire is not yet permanent. The employer evaluates the worker's suitability before confirming full employment. Common in both private companies and public service.

examples.japanese: {仮採用|かりさいよう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}です。
examples.english: The probationary period is three months.

examples.japanese: {仮採用|かりさいよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{待遇|たいぐう}→待遇：12517_taiguu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: At the probationary stage, you don't receive the same benefits as a regular employee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}ければ→良い：02350_yoi⟧、{仮採用|かりさいよう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本採用|ほんさいよう}→本採用：13444_honsaiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わる→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧。
examples.english: If the supervisor's evaluation is good, the provisional hire converts to permanent employment.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧ (temporary, provisional) and ⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧ (hiring, employment). This word is part of the hiring vocabulary in Japanese workplaces, where a trial period is standard practice before full appointment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮採用|かりさいよう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: probationary period
- {仮採用|かりさいよう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本採用|ほんさいよう}→本採用：13444_honsaiyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: from provisional to permanent employment
- {仮採用|かりさいよう}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: provisional hiring notice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本採用|ほんさいよう}→本採用：13444_honsaiyou⟧: permanent hiring — the confirmed, full employment that follows the probationary period
- ⟦{試用期間|しようきかん}→試用期間：15675_shiyoukikan⟧: trial period — the time frame during which the provisional employment is evaluated; overlaps in meaning but focuses on the duration rather than the employment status
- ⟦{内定|ないてい}→内定：07499_naitei⟧: informal job offer — given before actual employment begins, especially to graduating students
